# PR #215: chore(release): promote main to production — frontend v2 at /v2

- State: merged (2026-10-11)
- Opened by Pukujan on 2026-10-11
- Original: https://github.com/Pukujan-lab/octo-database/pull/215
- Branch `promote/main-to-production-v2ui` into `production`, +18830 −5 in 124 files, merge commit 545563986ed522ece8e51f0ba9491fb9b5f494d2

Promotes the current `main` tree to `production`.

## What ships

**Frontend v2 at `/v2`** (new, #209) — a second React app under `frontend-v2/`, generated by app-builder-automation against `docs/specs/2026-10-11-frontend-v2-design-spec.md`. Six named design systems, each with dark and light variants, all driven by CSS custom properties, swapped by a dropdown and persisted. Dark by default. v1 stays at `/` untouched.

## Deploy path

- root `npm run build` now builds both apps
- `Dockerfile.web` installs and builds `frontend-v2` alongside `frontend`
- `Caddyfile` serves `/v2/*` with an SPA fallback scoped to `/v2`, plus a `/v2` → `/v2/` redirect
- `frontend-v2/package-lock.json` and `.npmrc` added so `npm ci` is reproducible

## Verification

- `npm ci` + `npm run build` pass; `dist/v2/index.html` references `/v2/assets/…`
- App driven in a browser against the local API: login, all five views, the design-system dropdown, the light/dark toggle, and the public share route — no console errors
- Docker image build could not be verified locally (Docker Desktop on the Windows dev box crashes); CI does not build the image either, so the Mac host's `deploy.sh` health check + auto-rollback is the gate
